searchText: > find the thread we had with decoupling of syncing If you find that thread could you link it, I am interested in reading more or is there a write up on `syncing decoupled`. I am interested in what requirements this could add. Because I want to build an execution client without devp2p, and instead uses a collection of Portal Network protocols to supplement whatever is need. Ideally in my mind with EIP-4444's the block history window for execution clients is the last 6 months. Then for execution clients to sync they would download a snapshot of the state from lets say the Portal State Network. Then ideally sync to latest from execution payloads from the CL client. Blocks could also potentially be retrieved from the Portal History Network, but I don't think that would be necessary as the payloads could just be retrieved from the consensus layer client. I think this would also compliment verkle Hi, it started here https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/688075293562503241/1285636135770521633
